title: Canon of the Zenith Lance
summary: A canon on drawing sun qi into a lance of light and driving it through guard and plate in one straight burn.

title: Treatise on the Mending Sun
summary: A treatise of the sun as healer that warms wounds shut and burns out poison and calls back a breath only just lost.

title: The Open Field Daystar Canon
summary: A canon on spreading the qi field wide and saturating it with heat and light until the ground itself holds the sun.

title: The Paired Suns Treatise
summary: A treatise on holding two small suns in the two hands and casting them in pairs so the first opens and the second finishes.

title: The Azure Court Dawn Manual
summary: A court manual of the sun as judge that rebukes with exact strokes and closes with a crowning blaze.

title: A Dual-Track Compendium of the Sun
summary: A compendium on running one track of sun qi for burning and one for mending at once so the user strikes and restores in the same breath.

title: Manual of the Sworn Daybreak
summary: A manual of the sun-sworn who vow to keep a companion alive and spend their own warmth to do it.

title: The Oath of the Open Noon
summary: A manual of the sworn open hand that fights in the full light and burns away every hiding place and every false front.

title: Treatise on the Unwalled Blaze
summary: A treatise on a blaze that has no walls and no end and that scours an open field of foes and foul air alike.
